metaTitle: Clash Royale Stats Command for Twitch | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Show your Clash Royale profile with !cr in Twitch chat. Set your player tag for deck cards, average elixir, Path of Legends rank and trophy road stats.
title: Clash Royale stats in Twitch chat.
lead: Viewers type !cr for your level, wins and clan, !cr decks for your current deck, or !cr ranked for Path of Legends. Enable the free module and enter your player tag. !cr road shows your trophies and arena.
howTitle: Link your player tag and try !cr.
step1Desc: Switch on Clash Royale Stats in the dashboard and enter your player tag, such as #P2LQ0GR, as the default player. The bot needs the tag to find your account.
step2Desc: Anyone can type !cr in chat. The bot replies with your level, win and loss record, win rate, three-crown wins and clan.
step3Desc: Each command has its own switch and message template in the dashboard. Keep the stats you want chat to see.
listTitle: Player tag, decks and Path of Legends.
item1Desc: Enter your player tag, such as #P2LQ0GR, as the default player. The bot looks up tags rather than player names.
item2Desc: Viewers can check another tag with !cr #P2LQ0GR. You can restrict player lookups to your linked account in the dashboard.
item3Desc: !cr decks lists the cards in your current battle deck and its average elixir cost. !crdecks and !crdeck return the same reply.
item4Desc: !cr ranked shows your Path of Legends standing. !cr road shows current trophies, your trophy record and arena.
limitsNote: The module is off by default. Each command has a 10 second cooldown.
faqQ1: How do I show my Clash Royale stats in Twitch chat?
faqA1: Enable Clash Royale Stats in the ItsBagelBot dashboard and enter your player tag. Viewers can then type !cr for your level, wins, losses, win rate, three-crown wins and clan.
faqA2: Yes. Type !cr decks, !crdecks or !crdeck. The bot lists your current battle deck with the average elixir cost.
faqQ3: Can it show my Path of Legends rank?
faqA3: Yes. !cr ranked shows your league, trophies and rank. If Path of Legends data is missing, the bot uses available legacy league data. If neither is available, it reports that you have no ranked record this season.
faqQ4: Why does it need a player tag and not my name?
faqA4: The bot looks up player tags rather than names. Enter a tag such as #P2LQ0GR once in the dashboard for commands without a tag, or type !cr #P2LQ0GR to look up that player.
faqQ5: Is it free, and where does the data come from?
faqA5: Yes. Clash Royale Stats is included in the free plan. Profile data comes from the Clash Royale API through the RoyaleAPI proxy.

tblNote: Replies use the default templates with sample values. Real numbers come from each player's Clash Royale profile.
demoTitle: Checking a profile and a deck.
prereq1: Enable Clash Royale Stats in the dashboard. The module is off by default.
prereq2: Your player tag, such as #P2LQ0GR, for commands that have no tag in chat.
